SELECT DISTINCT ?modelName WHERE {
  ?campaign rc:affectsComponent ?component .
  ?component rc:name "SERVICE BRAKES, HYDRAULIC:ANTILOCK/TRACTION CONTROL/ELECTRONIC LIMITED SLIP:CONTROL UNIT/MODULE" .
  ?campaign rc:affects ?variant .
  ?variant rc:ofModel ?model .
  ?model rc:name ?modelName .
}
ORDER BY ?modelName

sparql_tries.sparql:
SELECT ?campaignNumber (COUNT(DISTINCT ?makeName) AS ?brandCount) (GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ?makeName; separator=", ") AS ?brands)
WHERE {
  ?c rc:campaignNumber ?campaignNumber ;
     rc:affects ?v .
  ?v rc:ofModel ?m .
  ?m rc:ofMake ?make .
  ?make rc:name ?makeName .
  FILTER(?makeName IN ("HYUNDAI", "KIA", "GENESIS"))
}
GROUP BY ?campaignNumber
HAVING (COUNT(DISTINCT ?makeName) > 1)
ORDER BY DESC(?brandCount) ?campaignNumber
SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?campaign) AS ?count) WHERE { ?campaign a rc:RecallCampaign ; rc:initiatedBy ?initiator . FILTER(CONTAINS(UCASE(STR(?initiator)), "ODI")) }
